title: Video signature
description: A tool-agnostic personal motion-signature spec for video-style-kit. Specified in percentages, seconds and named color roles — never pixels or a renderer-specific easing name — so it renders the same in HyperFrames, Remotion, After Effects or anything else.

accentColorToken.description: Usually "{{ACCENT_COLOR}}" to inherit the project's brand color, or a literal hex.

mode.description: bookend = alone on screen at open/close only. continuous = a small looping mark in a fixed corner for the whole video.

holdSeconds.description: bookend only: how long the mark holds alone at each end.

insetPct.description: continuous only: inset from each edge, as % of frame.

primitives.description: Which causal/structural devices are in play, and their timing. Disable any that don't fit your content — not every signature needs all of them.

ripple.description: One main object transforming in place. The common case; usually always enabled.

bridge.description: Line + traveling dot between two separate objects with a real cause→effect.

chain.description: Bridge fired sequentially for a terminating multi-step process.

fan.description: One cause, several simultaneous effects (or the reverse).

loop.description: Chain whose last step reconnects to its first; continuous, never fades.

timeline.description: A persistent progression axis (years, measures, steps — any ordered axis).

compare.description: Parallel co-equal alternatives. Never a connecting line between them.

origin.description: At most once per video: a stylistically distinct narrative cold-open.

analogy.description: At most once per video: a relatable image morphs into the technical diagram.

default.description: The baseline rule: one accent, reserved for whatever matters right now.

categoryPalette.description: Named exception: a small fixed hue-per-type palette, scoped to taxonomy/architecture beats only.

statePalette.description: Named exception: color marks progress through a process, scoped to algorithm/state-diagram beats only.

modalGrading.description: Whether a whole-palette shift is used to signal a change of narrative mode (e.g. an Origin vignette).

footageContainment.description: match-restraint: overlay directly on real footage, weight matched to your line/accent language. margin-only: never touch real footage directly, use a dedicated strip. direct-bold: cartoon-weight overlay is fine, it's the brand.

mechanismVsMeaningBoundary.description: If true, purely interpretive/thematic beats (no literal on-screen cause/effect) get Pulse only — never force a causal primitive onto an opinion.

notes.description: Freeform: aesthetic references, what to avoid copying, anything a future reader needs.

pathStyle.description: curve = smooth bezier (the original default). grid-snapped = right-angle hops, for a more systems/circuit feeling.
